name: Victoria A. Lozzi
office: City of Palos Verdes Estates, Member of the City Council

items.text: Victoria A. Lozzi serves on the Palos Verdes Estates City Council and previously served as mayor and city treasurer. She had a 35-year corporate banking career. During a July 2026 council meeting, Lozzi expressed concern that the city hires consultants without fully implementing their recommendations. She noted that residents generally support funding services but are less supportive of spending on buildings or pensions. She highlighted significant unfunded infrastructure needs, including $8.8 million for street improvements and $2.2 million in additional roadway needs. Lozzi voted against drafting a ballot measure to replace an expiring police funding measure, citing a proposed carve-out for pension obligations. She had moved to lower the proposal's annual pension carve-out to $750,000, but that motion failed.
